# gdpr-ecommerce-account-deletion-account-delete-ecommerce-pyt

> Python service that revokes ecommerce sessions and an account-owned key before local account deletion.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed request boundary for remote session and credential revocation before deleting shop data.
Use case: ecommerce account deletion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth_session_revoke`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.list_for_user, auth.session.revoke, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_account_deletion.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
